ai-cybersecurity.title: AI in cybersecurity
ai-cybersecurity.short: Use AI to analyze data, spot suspicious patterns, and strengthen system security.

ai-crm.title: AI in CRM
ai-crm.short: Smarter CRM, customer analysis, behavior prediction, and better relationships.
ai-crm.description: Customer behavior analysis, lead scoring, need prediction, and next-best-action suggestions — turning your CRM into a growth engine.

ai-retail.title: AI for retail
ai-retail.short: Smarter stores, product recommendations, customer analysis, sales and support automation.
ai-retail.description: Product recommendations, personalized shopping, support automation, and sales analytics — for online and omnichannel retail.

ai-extraction.title: AI data extraction
ai-extraction.short: Extract, classify, and process information from documents, files, images, and more.
ai-extraction.description: From PDFs and images to emails and forms — we extract, structure, and inject data into your systems.

ai-legal.title: AI for legal work
ai-legal.short: Legal document analysis, smart search, classification, and process support.
ai-legal.description: Smart document search, contract classification, and legal workflow support — with confidentiality and human control.
